trap.label: in the event of
trap.wrong: In case of fire, we will pay the sum insured.
trap.right: In the event of fire, we will pay the sum insured.
trap.why: Em português “em caso de” serve para tudo. Em inglês, in case (of) é por precaução; para cobertura use in the event of.

mcq.q: “Provided that you took reasonable care” is a...

fix.wrong: Provided that you take reasonable care, we paid.
fix.right: Provided that you take reasonable care, we will pay.

fix.wrong: We cover all but not deliberate damage.
fix.right: We cover all except deliberate damage.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in the event of: “If there is a fire, we pay.”
rewrite.answer: In the event of fire, we pay.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com provided that: “Only if you take reasonable care, we will pay.”
rewrite.answer: Provided that you take reasonable care, we will pay.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com except: “We exclude deliberate damage.”
rewrite.answer: We cover all except deliberate damage.
